description: This file implements an audio filter class for real-time audio enhancement using the ai-coustics' AIC SDK within the Pipecat framework. It handles initialization, parameter configuration, starting/stopping the model, processing audio frames, and managing internal buffers for streaming audio processing.

classes.name: AICFilter
classes.description: An audio filter class that leverages the ai-coustics AIC SDK to perform real-time audio enhancement, with capabilities to start, stop, process frames, and configure parameters.

methods.name: get_vad_factory(self)
methods.description: Returns a factory function that creates a Voice Activity Detector (VAD) bound to the initialized AIC model.

methods.name: create_vad_analyzer( self, *, lookback_buffer_size: Optional[float] = None, sensitivity: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Creates and returns a lazily-initialized AICVADAnalyzer configured with optional lookback buffer size and sensitivity parameters.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes the AIC model with the given sample rate, configuring parameters such as enhancement level and voice gain, and logs setup details.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Cleans up the AIC model and clears internal buffers when stopping the filter.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes incoming control frames to enable or disable filtering, updating internal parameters accordingly.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes input audio bytes through the AIC model to produce enhanced output, buffering incomplete frames for continuous streaming.

methods.name: None __init__( self, *, license_key: str = "", model_type: AICModelType = AICModelType.QUAIL_STT, enhancement_level: Optional[float] = 1.0, voice_gain: Optional[float] = 1.0, noise_gate_enable: Optional[bool] = True, )
